authorization: User requested sequential execution: five new parents, two continuations, three schedules; common-8k switch experiment; then fresh-parent cost-inclusive comparison. Later stages depend on preceding scientific gates and frozen execution specifications.
objective: final equal-weight mean success over four tasks

stage1.parent_retention: reference action evaluated once; reported separately from the primary three-schedule choice
primary_estimands: cross-continuation and cross-case-half parent-informed choice gain vs prespecified BP and leave-parent-out fixed choice
secondary_estimands: held-out choice regret within the three measured methods

gate.type: exploratory resource decision, not a significance test or proof of absence

stage2.parents: stage1 development parents, never called independent confirmation
stage2.fixed_method: highest stage1 grand mean among three fixed schedules, deterministic tie priority
stage2.alternative: highest stage1 grand mean among the remaining two schedules, same tie priority
stage2.rule_family: one threshold on a single decision-time diagnostic score; exact score, direction and finite threshold family frozen before stage2 outcome inspection
stage2.validation: leave whole original parent out, including threshold fitting; no final outcome features
stage2.gate: repeatable switch/keep differences plus held-out rule gain over both constant decisions; uncertainty and per-parent influence reported
stage2.stage3_full_sample_size: freeze from stage2 variability and target precision before new-parent outcomes; no automatic expansion

stage3.parents: fresh originals never used for stage1/2 method or rule selection
stage3.final_research_scoring: same disjoint outcome bank across arms, never returned to the allocator; accounted separately
stage3.primary_effect: diagnostic_rule minus strong_fixed at equal 40k total budget
stage3.scientific_success: prespecified meaningful net effect with uncertainty excluding non-positive gain, alongside positive information effect; freeze exact threshold and sample size before stage3
